source.description: Run Hermes in Herdr with optional monitoring

goal.en: Run a dedicated Hermes Gateway inside Herdr with explicit lifecycle control, persistent pause intent and JSON diagnostics. A compact startup page opens an optional hqtui monitor for multiple Profiles, with live status, CPU and memory trends.
goal.zh: 在 Herdr 内运行专用 Hermes Gateway，提供明确的生命周期控制、持久暂停意图与 JSON 诊断。启动时先显示简洁状态页，按需打开 hqtui 面板，查看多个 Profile 的实时状态、CPU 和内存趋势。

role.en: Optional responsive terminal dashboard and startup status page
role.zh: 按需打开的自适应终端监控面板与启动状态页

role.en: Bounded Herdr and Hermes control exchanges
role.zh: 有时限的 Herdr 与 Hermes 控制通信

role.en: Singleton locks, persistent intent and request deduplication
role.zh: 单例锁、持久意图与请求去重

role.en: Process identity, resource sampling and Profile configuration checks
role.zh: 进程身份、资源采样与专用 Profile 配置预检

role.en: Development hooks, actions and pane registration
role.zh: 开发用 hooks、actions 与 pane 注册

role.en: Isolated process, RPC and terminal interaction tests
role.zh: 隔离的进程、RPC 与终端交互测试

subject.en: Brushed-brass gateway with an ajar petrol enamel door, ivory terminal inlay and green status lens
subject.zh: 拉丝黄铜门框、微开的深蓝珐琅门、象牙色终端嵌字与绿色状态灯

description.en: The substantial frame and slightly open door read as one compact gateway. Both hinges, the status lens and complete feet remain visible, with 205.5 px clearance from the rounded outline.
description.zh: 厚实门框与微开的门扉形成紧凑整体。两枚铰链、状态灯和完整支脚均保留，距圆角边界最近为 205.5 px。

description.en: Brushed brass surrounds petrol-blue enamel with an opaque ivory terminal inlay. The green lens keeps its contained glass highlight; the real opening is transparent and every opaque extracted native pixel retains its RGB.
description.zh: 拉丝黄铜包围深蓝珐琅门面，象牙色终端嵌字保持不透明。绿色镜片保留内部玻璃高光，真实门洞透明，提取后所有不透明原生像素的 RGB 均不变。

title.en: Paired panes and a return route

description.en: Unequal pane outlines and one returning route form a shallow relief on pale blue-gray paper. Paper, grain and projected shadow are independent layers; these designed colors do not imply an existing website theme.
description.zh: 大小不同的窗格与一条回程线路在浅蓝灰纸面形成浅浮纹。纸底、颗粒与投影各自独立，这套设计配色不代表已有的网站主题。

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px, the brass frame, enamel door and terminal prompt remain readable. At 32/24/16 px, the door silhouette and brass-blue contrast carry recognition; hinges, lens and inlay detail merge. Sidebar and browser specimens demonstrate scale; the source currently supplies a CLI and development manifest.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 可辨认黄铜门框、珐琅门面与终端提示符；32/24/16 px 依靠门框轮廓和金蓝对比识别，铰链、状态灯与嵌字细节会合并。侧栏和浏览器示例仅展示尺寸，源项目目前提供 CLI 与开发用 manifest。
